040/**
041 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link UonParser}.
042 *
043 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
044 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
048 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/UonSupport">UON Basics</a>
049
050 * </ul>
051 */
052@SuppressWarnings({
053   "java:S110",   // Deep inheritance inherent to the serializer/parser session hierarchy
054   "java:S125",   // State-machine comments are documentation, not commented-out code
055   "java:S115",   // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., CONST_value)
056   "rawtypes",    // Raw types necessary for generic type handling
057   "resource",    // UonReader is managed by caller
058   "unchecked"    // Type erasure requires unchecked casts
059})
060public class UonParserSession extends ReaderParserSession implements HttpPartParserSession, RecordReadable {
061
062   // Property name constants
063   private static final String PROP_decoding = "decoding";
064   private static final String PROP_validateEnd = "validateEnd";
065   private static final String PROP_UonParserSession_validateEnd = "UonParserSession.validateEnd";
066
067   /**
068    * Builder class.
069    */
070   @SuppressWarnings({
071      "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
072   })
073   public abstract static class Builder<SELF extends Builder<SELF>> extends ReaderParserSession.Builder<SELF> {
074
075      private boolean decoding;
076      private boolean validateEnd;
077
078      /**
079       * Constructor
080       *
081       * @param ctx The context creating this session.
082       */
083      protected Builder(UonParser ctx) {
084         super(ctx);
085         decoding = ctx.decoding;
086         validateEnd = ctx.isValidateEnd();
087      }
088
089      @Override
090      public UonParserSession build() {
091         return new UonParserSession(this);
092      }
093
094      /**
095       * Overrides the decoding flag on the context for this session.
096       *
097       * @param value The new value for this setting.
098       * @return This object.
099       */
100      public SELF decoding(boolean value) {
101         decoding = value;
102         return self();
103      }
104
105      @Override /* Overridden from Builder */
106      public SELF property(String key, Object value) {
107         if (key == null) { super.property(key, value); return self(); }
108         switch (key) {
109            case PROP_decoding:
110               return decoding(cvt(value, Boolean.class));
111            case PROP_validateEnd, PROP_UonParserSession_validateEnd:
112               return validateEnd(cvt(value, Boolean.class));
113            default:
114               super.property(key, value);
115               return self();
116         }
117      }
118
119      /**
120       * Validate end.
121       *
122       * @param value The new value for this setting.
123       * @return This object.
124       */
125      public SELF validateEnd(boolean value) {
126         validateEnd = value;
127         return self();
128      }
129
130   }

132   /**
133    * Concrete default builder leaf for the non-subclassed {@code create()} path (CRTP terminal).
134    */
135   public static final class DefaultBuilder extends Builder<DefaultBuilder> {
136
137      DefaultBuilder(UonParser ctx) {
138         super(ctx);
139      }
140   }
141
142   // Characters that need to be preceded with an escape character.
143   private static final AsciiSet escapedChars = AsciiSet.of("~'\u0001\u0002");
144
145   private static final char AMP = '\u0001';  // Flags set in reader to denote & and = characters.
146   private static final char EQ = '\u0002';
147   private static final AsciiSet endCharsParam = AsciiSet.of("" + AMP);
148   private static final AsciiSet endCharsNormal = AsciiSet.of(",)" + AMP);
149
150   /**
151    * Creates a new builder for this object.
152    *
153    * @param ctx The context creating this session.
154    * @return A new builder.
155    */
156   @SuppressWarnings({
157      "java:S1452" // Builder<?> wildcard return intentional; callers use it to construct session instances polymorphically
158   })
159   public static Builder<?> create(UonParser ctx) {
160      return new DefaultBuilder(ctx);
161   }

163   /*
164    * Returns true if the next character in the stream is preceded by an escape '~' character.
165    */
166   private static final boolean isInEscape(int c, ParserReader r, boolean prevIsInEscape) throws IOException {
167      if (c == '~' && ! prevIsInEscape) {
168         c = r.peek();
169         if (escapedChars.contains(c)) {
170            r.delete();
171            return true;
172         }
173      }
174      return false;
175   }
176
177   private static void skipSpace(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
178      int c = 0;
179      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
180         if (c <= 2 || ! Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
181            r.unread();
182            return;
183         }
184      }
185   }

187   private final boolean decoding;
188   private final boolean validateEnd;

191    * Constructor.
192    *
193    * @param builder The builder for this object.
194    */
195   protected UonParserSession(Builder<?> builder) {
196      super(builder);
197      decoding = builder.decoding;
198      validateEnd = builder.validateEnd;
199   }

211   /**
212    * Creates a {@link UonReader} from the specified parser pipe.
213    *
214    * @param pipe The parser input.
215    * @param decodeChars Whether the reader should automatically decode URL-encoded characters.
216    * @return A new {@link UonReader} object.
217    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
218    */
219   public static final UonReader getUonReader(ParserPipe pipe, boolean decodeChars) throws IOException {
220      var r = pipe.getReader();
221      if (r instanceof UonReader r2)
222         return r2;
223      return new UonReader(pipe, decodeChars);
224   }

226   @Override /* Overridden from HttpPartParser */
227   public <T> T read(HttpPartType partType, HttpPartSchema schema, String in, ClassMeta<T> toType) throws ParseException, SchemaValidationException {
228      if (in == null)
229         return null;
230      if (toType.isString() && ine(in)) {
231         // Shortcut - If we're returning a string and the value doesn't start with "'" or is "null", then
232         // just return the string since it's a plain value.
233         // This allows us to bypass the creation of a UonParserSession object.
234         char x = firstNonWhitespaceChar(in);
235         if (x != '\'' && x != 'n' && in.indexOf('~') == -1)
236            return (T)in;
237         if (x == 'n' && "null".equals(in))
238            return null;
239      }
240      try (var pipe = createPipe(in)) {
241         try (var r = getUonReader(pipe, false)) {
242            return readAnything(toType, r, null, true, null);
243         }
244      } catch (ParseException e) {
245         throw e;
246      } catch (Exception e) {
247         throw new ParseException(e);
248      }
249   }
250
251   /**
252    * Workhorse method.
253    *
254    * @param <T> The class type being parsed, or <jk>null</jk> if unknown.
255    * @param eType The class type being parsed, or <jk>null</jk> if unknown.
256    * @param r The reader being parsed.
257    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
258    * @param outer The outer object (for constructing nested inner classes).
259    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> if there is no enclosing (outer) object; the parsed object is then not linked to a parent.
260    * @param isUrlParamValue
261    *    If <jk>true</jk>, then we're parsing a top-level URL-encoded value which is treated a bit different than the
262    *    default case.
263    * @param pMeta The current bean property being parsed.
264    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> if no bean property metadata applies (e.g. the root value or an unknown property).
265    * @return The parsed object.
266    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
267    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
268    * @throws ExecutableException Exception occurred on invoked constructor/method/field.
269    */
270   @SuppressWarnings({
271      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser state machine
272      "java:S6541"  // Synchronization not needed for session-local state
273   })
274   public <T> T readAnything(ClassMeta<?> eType, UonReader r, Object outer, boolean isUrlParamValue, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
275
276      if (eType == null)
277         eType = object();
278      var swap = (ObjectSwap<T,Object>)eType.getSwap(this);
279      var builder = (BuilderSwap<T,Object>)eType.getBuilderSwap(this);
280      ClassMeta<?> sType = null;
281      if (nn(builder))
282         sType = builder.getBuilderClassMeta(this);
283      else if (nn(swap))
284         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
285      else
286         sType = eType;
287
288      if (sType.isOptional())
289         return (T)o(readAnything(eType.getElementType(), r, outer, isUrlParamValue, pMeta));
290
291      setCurrentClass(sType);
292
293      Object o = null;
294
295      int c = r.peekSkipWs();
296
297      if (c == -1 || c == AMP) {
298         // If parameter is blank and it's an array or collection, return an empty list.
299         if (sType.isCollectionOrArray())
300            o = sType.newInstance();
301         else if (sType.isString() || sType.isObject())
302            o = "";
303         else if (sType.isPrimitive())
304            o = sType.getPrimitiveDefault();
305         // Otherwise, leave null.
306      } else if (sType.isVoid()) {
307         var s = readString(r, isUrlParamValue);
308         if (nn(s))
309            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected 'null' for void value, but was '%s'.", s);
310      } else if (sType.isObject()) {
311         if (c == '(') {
312            var m = newGenericMap();
313            readIntoMap(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
314            o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
315         } else if (c == '@') {
316            Collection l = newGenericList();
317            o = readIntoCollection(r, l, sType, isUrlParamValue, pMeta);
318         } else {
319            var s = readString(r, isUrlParamValue);
320            if (c != '\'') {
321               if ("true".equals(s) || "false".equals(s))
322                  o = b(s);
323               else {
324                  if (isNumeric(s))
325                     o = StringUtils.parseNumber(s, Number.class);
326                  else
327                     o = s;
328               }
329            } else {
330               o = s;
331            }
332         }
333      } else if (nn(builder)) {
334         var m = toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
335         m = readIntoBeanMap(r, m);
336         o = m == null ? null : builder.build(this, m.getBean(), eType);
337      } else if (sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
338         var m = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner());
339         m = readIntoBeanMap(r, m);
340         o = m == null ? null : m.getBean();
341      } else if (sType.isMap()) {
342         var m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
343         o = readIntoMap(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta);
344      } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
345         if (c == '(') {
346            var m = newGenericMap();
347            readIntoMap(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
348            // Handle case where it's a collection, but serialized as a map with a _type or _value key.
349            if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(sType)))
350               o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
351            // Handle case where it's a collection, but only a single value was specified.
352            else {
353               var l = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericList());
354               l.add(m.cast(sType.getElementType()));
355               o = l;
356            }
357         } else {
358            var l = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericList());
359            o = readIntoCollection(r, l, sType, isUrlParamValue, pMeta);
360         }
361      } else if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) {
362         if (c == '(') {
363            var m = newGenericMap();
364            readIntoMap(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
365            // Handle case where it's an array, but serialized as a map with a _type or _value key.
366            if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(sType)))
367               o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
368            // Handle case where it's an array, but only a single value was specified.
369            else {
370               var l = listOfSize(1);
371               l.add(m.cast(sType.getElementType()));
372               o = toArray(sType, l);
373            }
374         } else {
375            var l = (ArrayList)readIntoCollection(r, list(), sType, isUrlParamValue, pMeta);
376            o = toArray(sType, l);
377         }
378      } else if (sType.isCharSequence()) {
379         o = readString(r, isUrlParamValue);
380      } else if (sType.isChar()) {
381         o = parseCharacter(readString(r, isUrlParamValue));
382      } else if (sType.isNumber()) {
383         o = readNumber(r, (Class<? extends Number>)sType.inner());
384      } else if (sType.isBoolean()) {
385         o = readBoolean(r);
386      } else if (sType.isDate()) {
387         o = readDate(readString(r, isUrlParamValue), sType);
388      } else if (sType.isCalendar()) {
389         o = readCalendar(readString(r, isUrlParamValue), sType);
390      } else if (sType.isTemporal()) {
391         o = readTemporal(readString(r, isUrlParamValue), sType);
392      } else if (sType.isDuration()) {
393         o = readDuration(readString(r, isUrlParamValue));
394      } else if (sType.isPeriod()) {
395         o = readPeriod(readString(r, isUrlParamValue));
396      } else if (sType.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(outer)) {
397         var s = readString(r, isUrlParamValue);
398         if (nn(s))
399            o = sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, s);
400      } else if (c == '(') {
401         // It could be a non-bean with _type attribute.
402         var m = newGenericMap();
403         readIntoMap(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
404         if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(sType)))
405            o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
406         else if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
407            o = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m).getBean();
408         else
409            throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
410      } else if (c == 'n') {
411         @SuppressWarnings({
412            "unused" // Intentionally unused; variable/parameter is required by the interface contract
413         })
414         int ignored = r.read();
415         readNull(r);
416      } else {
417         throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
418      }
419
420      if (o == null && sType.isPrimitive())
421         o = sType.getPrimitiveDefault();
422      if (nn(swap) && nn(o))
423         o = unswap(swap, o, eType);
424
425      if (nn(parentBean()))
426         setParent(eType, o, parentBean());
427
428      return (T)o;
429   }

431   @SuppressWarnings({
432      "java:S2447" // null is a valid UON value distinct from true/false; Boolean (boxed) is deliberately used for this tristate
433   })
434   private Boolean readBoolean(UonReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
435      var s = readString(r, false);
436      if (s == null || s.equals("null"))
437         return null;
438      if (eqic(s, "true"))
439         return true;
440      if (eqic(s, "false"))
441         return false;
442      throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized syntax for boolean.  '%s'.", s);
443   }
444
445   @SuppressWarnings({
446      "java:S1168",    // Intentionally returns null for empty/EOF or readAttrName('%00') in this parser state machine.
447      "java:S2583",    // S1 checks c==-1/AMP for defensive completeness; while-guard makes these sub-expressions always-false
448      "java:S3776",    // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic
449      "java:S6541",    // Single-threaded session contexts do not require synchronization
450   })
451   private <T> BeanMap<T> readIntoBeanMap(UonReader r, BeanMap<T> m) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
452
453      int c = r.readSkipWs();
454      if (c == -1 || c == AMP)
455         return null;
456      if (c == 'n')
457         return (BeanMap<T>)readNull(r);
458      if (c != '(')
459         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected '(' at beginning of object.");
460
461      // S1: Looking for attrName start.
462      // S2: Found attrName end, looking for =.
463      // S3: Found =, looking for valStart.
464      // S4: Looking for , or }
465
466      var state = S1;
467      var currAttr = "";
468      var pb = swapParentBean(m.getBean(false));
469      mark();
470      try {
471         while (true) {
472            c = r.read();
473            if (state == S1) {
474               if (c == ')' || c == -1 || c == AMP) {
475                  return m;
476               }
477               if (Character.isWhitespace(c))
478                  skipSpace(r);
479               else {
480                  r.unread();
481                  mark();
482                  currAttr = readAttrName(r, decoding);
483                  if (currAttr == null) { // Value was '%00'
484                     return null;
485                  }
486                  state = S2;
487               }
488            } else if (state == S2) {
489               if (c == EQ || c == '=')
490                  state = S3;
491               else if (c == -1 || c == ',' || c == ')' || c == AMP) {
492                  m.put(currAttr, null);
493                  if (c == ')' || c == -1 || c == AMP) {
494                     return m;
495                  }
496                  state = S1;
497               }
498            } else if (state == S3) {
499               if (c == -1 || c == ',' || c == ')' || c == AMP) {
500                  if (! currAttr.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName((ClassMeta<?>) m.getBeanInfo()))) {
501                     var pMeta = m.getPropertyMeta(currAttr);
502                     if (pMeta == null) {
503                        onUnknownProperty(currAttr, m, null);
504                        unmark();
505                     } else {
506                        unmark();
507                        var value = convertToType("", (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo());
508                        try {
509                           pMeta.set(m, currAttr, value);
510                        } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
511                           onBeanSetterException(pMeta, e);
512                           throw e;
513                        }
514                     }
515                  }
516                  if (c == -1 || c == ')' || c == AMP)
517                     return m;
518                  state = S1;
519               } else {
520                  if (! currAttr.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName((ClassMeta<?>) m.getBeanInfo()))) {
521                     var pMeta = m.getPropertyMeta(currAttr);
522                     if (pMeta == null) {
523                        onUnknownProperty(currAttr, m, readAnything(object(), r.unread(), m.getBean(false), false, null));
524                        unmark();
525                     } else {
526                        unmark();
527                        setCurrentProperty(pMeta);
528                        var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
529                        var value = readAnything(cm, r.unread(), m.getBean(false), false, pMeta);
530                        setName(cm, value, currAttr);
531                        try {
532                           pMeta.set(m, currAttr, value);
533                        } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
534                           onBeanSetterException(pMeta, e);
535                           throw e;
536                        }
537                        setCurrentProperty(null);
538                     }
539                  }
540                  state = S4;
541               }
542            } else if (state == S4) {
543               if (c == ',')
544                  state = S1;
545               else if (c == ')' || c == -1 || c == AMP) {
546                  return m;
547               }
548            }
549         }
550      } finally {
551         unmark();
552         swapParentBean(pb);
553      }
554   }
555
556   @SuppressWarnings({
557      "java:S1168",    // Intentionally returns null for EOF/AMP in this parser state machine.
558      "java:S1854",    // argIndex=0 is the valid starting arg index; Sonar FP on early-return paths that never read it
559      "java:S2583",    // State variables persist across loop iterations
560      "java:S2589",    // Final if (state==S3) is always true given prior check; exhaustive state error-reporting pattern
561      "java:S6541",    // Brain method acceptable for parser state machine
562      "java:S3776"     // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser state machine
563   })
564   private <E> Collection<E> readIntoCollection(UonReader r, Collection<E> l, ClassMeta<E> type, boolean isUrlParamValue, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta)
565      throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
566
567      int c = r.readSkipWs();
568      if (c == -1 || c == AMP)
569         return null;
570      if (c == 'n')
571         return (Collection<E>)readNull(r);
572
573      int argIndex = 0;
574
575      // If we're parsing a top-level parameter, we're allowed to have comma-delimited lists outside parenthesis (e.g. "&foo=1,2,3&bar=a,b,c")
576      // This is not allowed at lower levels since we use comma's as end delimiters.
577      boolean isInParens = (c == '@');
578      if (! isInParens) {
579         if (isUrlParamValue)
580            r.unread();
581         else
582            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find '(' marking beginning of collection.");
583      } else {
584         @SuppressWarnings({
585            "unused" // Intentionally unused; variable/parameter is required by the interface contract
586         })
587         int ignored = r.read();
588      }
589
590      if (isInParens) {
591         // S1: Looking for starting of first entry.
592         // S2: Looking for starting of subsequent entries.
593         // S3: Looking for , or ) after first entry.
594
595         var state = S1;
596         while (c != -1 && c != AMP) {
597            c = r.read();
598            if (state == S1 || state == S2) {
599               if (c == ')') {
600                  if (state == S2) {
601                     l.add((E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), r.unread(), l, false, pMeta));
602                     @SuppressWarnings({
603                        "unused" // Intentionally unused; variable/parameter is required by the interface contract
604                     })
605                     int ignored = r.read();
606                  }
607                  return l;
608               } else if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
609                  skipSpace(r);
610               } else {
611                  l.add((E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), r.unread(), l, false, pMeta));
612                  state = S3;
613               }
614            } else if (state == S3) {
615               if (c == ',') {
616                  state = S2;
617               } else if (c == ')') {
618                  return l;
619               }
620            }
621         }
622         if (state == S1 || state == S2)
623            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find start of entry in array.");
624         if (state == S3)
625            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find end of entry in array.");
626
627      } else {
628         // S1: Looking for starting of entry.
629         // S2: Looking for , or & or END after first entry.
630
631         var state = S1;
632         while (c != -1 && c != AMP) {
633            c = r.read();
634            if (state == S1) {
635               if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
636                  skipSpace(r);
637               } else {
638                  l.add((E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), r.unread(), l, false, pMeta));
639                  state = S2;
640               }
641            } else if (state == S2) {
642               if (c == ',') {
643                  state = S1;
644               } else if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
645                  skipSpace(r);
646               } else if (c == AMP || c == -1) {
647                  r.unread();
648                  return l;
649               }
650            }
651         }
652      }
653
654      return null;  // Unreachable.
655   }
656
657   @SuppressWarnings({
658      "java:S1168",    // Intentionally returns null for EOF/AMP in this parser state machine.
659      "java:S2583",    // Defensive c==-1/AMP sub-checks inside the while(c!=-1 && c!=AMP) loop; kept for state-machine completeness.
660      "java:S6541",    // Brain method acceptable for parser state machine
661      "java:S3776"     // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser state machine
662   })
663   private <K,V> Map<K,V> readIntoMap(UonReader r, Map<K,V> m, ClassMeta<K> keyType, ClassMeta<V> valueType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
664
665      if (keyType == null)
666         keyType = (ClassMeta<K>)string();
667
668      int c = r.read();
669      if (c == -1 || c == AMP)
670         return null;
671      if (c == 'n')
672         return (Map<K,V>)readNull(r);
673      if (c != '(')
674         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected '(' at beginning of object.");
675
676      // S1: Looking for attrName start.
677      // S2: Found attrName end, looking for =.
678      // S3: Found =, looking for valStart.
679      // S4: Looking for , or )
680
681      var state = S1;
682      K currAttr = null;
683      while (c != -1 && c != AMP) {
684         c = r.read();
685         if (state == S1) {
686            if (c == ')')
687               return m;
688            if (Character.isWhitespace(c))
689               skipSpace(r);
690            else {
691               r.unread();
692               var attr = readAttr(r, decoding);
693               currAttr = attr == null ? null : convertAttrToType(m, trim(attr.toString()), keyType);
694               state = S2;
695            }
696         } else if (state == S2) {
697            if (c == EQ || c == '=')
698               state = S3;
699            else if (c == -1 || c == ',' || c == ')' || c == AMP) {
700               if (currAttr == null) {
701                  // Value was '%00'
702                  r.unread();
703                  return null;
704               }
705               m.put(currAttr, null);
706               if (c == ')' || c == -1 || c == AMP)
707                  return m;
708               state = S1;
709            }
710         } else if (state == S3) {
711            if (c == -1 || c == ',' || c == ')' || c == AMP) {
712               V value = convertAttrToType(m, "", valueType);
713               m.put(currAttr, value);
714               if (c == -1 || c == ')' || c == AMP)
715                  return m;
716               state = S1;
717            } else {
718               V value = readAnything(valueType, r.unread(), m, false, pMeta);
719               setName(valueType, value, currAttr);
720               m.put(currAttr, value);
721               state = S4;
722            }
723         } else if (state == S4) {
724            if (c == ',')
725               state = S1;
726            else if (c == ')' || c == -1 || c == AMP) {
727               return m;
728            }
729         }
730      }
731
732      return null; // Reachable via trailing comma at EOF (lenient parse of e.g. "(a=1,").
733   }
734
735   private Object readNull(UonReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
736      var s = readString(r, false);
737      if ("ull".equals(s))
738         return null;
739      throw new ParseException(this, "Unexpected character sequence: '%s'", s);
740   }
741
742   private Number readNumber(UonReader r, Class<? extends Number> c) throws IOException, ParseException {
743      var s = readString(r, false);
744      if (s == null)
745         return null;
746      return StringUtils.parseNumber(s, c);
747   }
748
749   /*
750    * Parses a string of the form "'foo'"
751    * All whitespace within parenthesis are preserved.
752    */
753   private String readPString(UonReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
754
755      @SuppressWarnings({
756         "unused" // Intentionally unused; variable/parameter is required by the interface contract
757      })
758      int ignored = r.read();
759      r.mark();
760      int c = 0;
761
762      boolean isInEscape = false;
763      while (c != -1) {
764         c = r.read();
765         if (! isInEscape && c == '\'')
766            return trim(r.getMarked(0, -1));
767         if (c == EQ)
768            r.replace('=');
769         isInEscape = isInEscape(c, r, isInEscape);
770      }
771      throw new ParseException(this, "Unmatched parenthesis");
772   }
773
774   /*
775    * Call this method after you've finished a parsing a string to make sure that if there's any
776    * remainder in the input, that it consists only of whitespace and comments.
777    */
778   private void validateEnd(UonReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
779      if (! isValidateEnd())
780         return;
781      while (true) {
782         var c = r.read();
783         if (c == -1)
784            return;
785         if (! Character.isWhitespace(c))
786            throw new ParseException(this, "Remainder after parse: '%s'.", (char)c);
787      }
788   }

792      try (var r = getUonReader(pipe, decoding)) {
793         T o = readAnything(type, r, getOuter(), true, null);
794         validateEnd(r);
795         return o;

837   /**
838    * Convenience method for parsing an attribute from the specified parser.
839    *
840    * @param r The reader.
841    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
842    * @param encoded Whether the attribute is encoded.
843    * @return The parsed object, or <jk>null</jk> if the attribute was the literal <js>"null"</js>.
844    * @throws IOException Exception thrown by underlying stream.
845    * @throws ParseException Attribute was malformed.
846    */
847   protected final Object readAttr(UonReader r, boolean encoded) throws IOException, ParseException {
848      return readAttrName(r, encoded);
849   }
850
851   /**
852    * Parses an attribute name from the specified reader.
853    *
854    * @param r The reader.
855    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
856    * @param encoded Whether the attribute is encoded.
857    * @return The parsed attribute name, or <jk>null</jk> if the attribute name was the literal <js>"null"</js>.
858    * @throws IOException Exception thrown by underlying stream.
859    * @throws ParseException Attribute name was malformed.
860    */
861   @SuppressWarnings({
862      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser state machine
863   })
864   protected final String readAttrName(UonReader r, boolean encoded) throws IOException, ParseException {
865
866      // If string is of form 'xxx', we're looking for ' at the end.
867      // Otherwise, we're looking for '&' or '=' or WS or -1 denoting the end of this string.
868
869      int c = r.peekSkipWs();
870      if (c == '\'')
871         return readPString(r);
872
873      r.mark();
874      boolean isInEscape = false;
875      if (encoded) {
876         while (true) {
877            c = r.read();
878            if (! isInEscape) {
879               if (c == AMP || c == EQ || c == -1 || Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
880                  if (c != -1)
881                     r.unread();
882                  var s = r.getMarked();
883                  return ("null".equals(s) ? null : s);
884               }
885            } else if (c == AMP)
886               r.replace('&');
887            else if (c == EQ)
888               r.replace('=');
889            isInEscape = isInEscape(c, r, isInEscape);
890         }
891      } else {
892         while (true) {
893            c = r.read();
894            if (! isInEscape && (c == '=' || c == -1 || Character.isWhitespace(c))) {
895               if (c != -1)
896                  r.unread();
897               var s = r.getMarked();
898               return ("null".equals(s) ? null : trim(s));
899            }
900            isInEscape = isInEscape(c, r, isInEscape);
901         }
902      }
903   }
904
905   /**
906    * Parses a string value from the specified reader.
907    *
908    * @param r The input reader.
909    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
910    * @param isUrlParamValue Whether this is a URL parameter.
911    * @return The parsed string, or <jk>null</jk> if the value was the literal <js>"null"</js>.
912    * @throws IOException Exception thrown by underlying stream.
913    * @throws ParseException Malformed input found.
914    */
915   protected final String readString(UonReader r, boolean isUrlParamValue) throws IOException, ParseException {
916
917      // If string is of form 'xxx', we're looking for ' at the end.
918      // Otherwise, we're looking for ',' or ')' or -1 denoting the end of this string.
919
920      int c = r.peekSkipWs();
921      if (c == '\'')
922         return readPString(r);
923
924      r.mark();
925      boolean isInEscape = false;
926      String s = null;
927      var endChars = (isUrlParamValue ? endCharsParam : endCharsNormal);
928      while (c != -1) {
929         c = r.read();
930         if (! isInEscape && endChars.contains(c)) {
931            // If this is a URL parameter value, we're looking for:  &
932            // If not, we're looking for:  &,)
933            r.unread();
934            c = -1;
935         }
936         if (c == -1)
937            s = r.getMarked();
938         else if (c == EQ)
939            r.replace('=');
940         else if (Character.isWhitespace(c) && ! isUrlParamValue) {
941            s = r.getMarked(0, -1);
942            skipSpace(r);
943            c = -1;
944         }
945         isInEscape = isInEscape(c, r, isInEscape);
946      }
947
948      if (isUrlParamValue)
949         s = StringUtils.trim(s);
950
951      return ("null".equals(s) ? null : trim(s));
952   }

957         .a(PROP_decoding, decoding)
958         .a(PROP_validateEnd, validateEnd);
959   }
